Twin tractor engines distribute thrust and structural bending moments, while Tricycle gear ensures stability during heavy taxiing and runway operations.

selected_configuration.name: Foam-Core Composite Shell (C1)
selected_configuration.description: Hot-wire cut XPS internal foam core wrapped in structural fiberglass and/or carbon fiber composite skin, supported by pultruded or roll-wrapped carbon spar tubes with local plywood/carbon hardpoints. High torsional and bending stiffness, smooth aerodynamic surface finish, and weather-proof durability.
selected_configuration.notes: Gold standard for commercial surveying, photogrammetry, and long-range missions.

ranked_configurations.name: Balsa Skeleton Composite D-Box (C2)
ranked_configurations.description: Internal skeleton formed by CNC/laser-cut balsa ribs and carbon spar tubes, sheeted with 1.0mm balsa wood, and overlaid with lightweight composite glass/carbon skin. Achieves exceptionally low structural weight while maintaining excellent aerodynamic contour accuracy and structural rigidity.
ranked_configurations.notes: Optimal balance of minimum empty weight and high aerodynamic efficiency for high-aspect-ratio gliders and light survey UAVs.

ranked_configurations.name: Balsa-Carbon Skeleton Film (C3)
ranked_configurations.description: Lightweight skeleton of balsa ribs and carbon spar, covered with heat-shrink film. Eliminates composite skin and sheeting weight, providing the highest payload-to-empty-weight fraction for gentle weather and low-speed endurance flights.
ranked_configurations.notes: Very low MTOW, high thermal endurance, easily field-repaired.

ranked_configurations.name: Traditional Wood Skeleton Film (C6)
ranked_configurations.description: Classic laser-cut balsa ribs with spruce/balsa beam spars, lite-ply fuselage formers and balsa longerons, covered in heat-shrink polyester film. No composite resins or specialized vacuum equipment required.
material_requirements: Spruce or Basswood Spar Caps (480 kg/m3)
ranked_configurations.notes: Traditional aeromodelling craft construction with excellent aesthetic appeal and moderate weight.

rejected_configurations.name: Depron Foam Sheet with Film (C4)
rejected_configurations.description: Depron closed-cell foam sheet airframe reinforced with carbon rod spars and covered with tape/film. Low-cost, rapid-build architecture suited for universities, flight training, and low-cost surveillance.

rejected_configurations.name: Folded Foam Board Monocoque (C5)

rejected_configurations.notes: Flite-Test style construction, ideal for classroom education and expendable testbeds.
